task: An investor runs a monthly SIP for 15 years (180 instalments) with a 10% annual step-up: the instalment is Rs 10,000 per month in year 1, Rs 11,000 in year 2, Rs 12,100 in year 3, and so on (multiply by 1.10 each year, no rounding). Each instalment is invested at the START of its month. The fund earns 12% a year compounded monthly, i.e. 1% per month, so an instalment invested at the start of month m (m = 1..180) is multiplied by 1.01^(181 - m) by the end of month 180. Compute, rounded to the nearest rupee: total_invested; future_value (value at the end of month 180); wealth_gained (future_value - total_invested); fv_without_stepup (future value if Rs 10,000 were invested every month with no step-up, same rules). RESULT keys: total_invested, future_value, wealth_gained, fv_without_stepup.

attempts.thought: To compute the total invested amount, I will sum the monthly SIP contributions over 15 years, applying a 10% step-up each year. The future value will be calculated by applying the compound interest formula for each installment based on when it was invested. I will also compute the future value without the step-up for comparison. I will assert that the total invested amount matches the sum of the step-up contributions and that the future value calculations are consistent across both methods.
attempts.code:
total_invested = 0
future_value = 0.0
monthly_rate = 0.01
n_months = 180
monthly_investment = 10000
step_up_rate = 1.1
step_up_years = 15
for year in range(step_up_years - 1):
    for month in range(12):
        month_index = year * 12 + month
        investment = monthly_investment * step_up_rate ** year
        total_invested += investment
        future_value += investment * (1 + monthly_rate) ** (n_months - month_index)
fv_without_stepup = sum((10000 * (1 + monthly_rate) ** (n_months - month) for month in range(n_months)))
wealth_gained = future_value - total_invested
RESULT = {'total_invested': round(total_invested), 'future_value': round(future_value), 'wealth_gained': round(wealth_gained), 'fv_without_stepup': round(fv_without_stepup)}
assert total_invested == sum((10000 * step_up_rate ** year * 12 for year in range(step_up_years))), f'Total invested mismatch: {total_invested} != {sum((10000 * step_up_rate ** year * 12 for year in range(step_up_years)))}'
assert abs(future_value - fv_without_stepup * (1 + monthly_rate) ** (n_months - 1)) < 1e-05, f'Future value mismatch: {future_value} != {fv_without_stepup * (1 + monthly_rate) ** (n_months - 1)}'
